messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Atom Editor
parts:
I’ve been playing around with Atom (https://atom.io) since I started working on
the code again and it’s been pretty good — we just need to figure out how to
turn the Emacs syntax highlighting into a format that Atom can recognize.
For the Emacs die-hards there are a bunch of plugins to Atom that implement
the usual Emacs shortcuts.
